Q: How to change spray color during painting process in visual components via a Python script? A:

…what are you talking about? "Spray color" or "painting simulation" have zero meaning in standard Python. If you're trying to automate something using Python, you'll at least need to tell us in more detail what exactly it is you're trying to automate.

Q: How to handle and sanitize user input strings in a web form using JavaScript? A:

You will have to do XSS prevention on the server-side too, if you're displaying stored data on your pages which comes from the database. And sql injection prevention when you are saving that data in the first place.

And obviously Authentication / Authorization, CSRF as well if you need them - although that's not related to XSS or SQL injection per se.

Q: Apparently my code is AI-generated (except it's not) A:

The thing is there are three levels of code quality widely available now; in decreasing order of quality:

  1. competent code
  2. AI code
  3. 90% of programmers

The odds are against AI being able to distinguish that final level of quality, and as the population increases it gets harder and harder. If you are in level 1 you will find this frustrating. As there is unlikely to be anyone else around who can understand, you may find talking to your agent therapeutic. Following the current trajectory a couple of decades into the future you may find that one day the only intelligent conversation available to you is artificial.
